The hub's 1-hop neighbourhood pages as 250+249, 250+250 and 101+101 records at limit 250, the last with nothing remaining, and a cursor at the end answers an empty page.
The hub's 1,201 seed changes page as 500 nodes, 101 nodes and 399 edges, then 201 edges at the default limit, and a cursor at the end answers an empty page.
A judged sample's pass rate and its Wilson interval at the stated confidence, 9500 when none is stated, are the closed-form values, with the bounds exactly 0 and 1 where nothing or everything passed.
Drawing twice with one seed, size and revision draws the same facts; another seed, the head, a larger size and a type filter draw exactly the facts their draw keys name.
A version made by WidenEdgeType lists its widened ends and one made by ModifyProperty its modified property, each from its own revision on, while added counts only new ids.
A node created at revision 1 is not found at revision 0 by describe or expand, is described at revision 1, and the overview counts it from the revision that recorded it.
After a subtype redeclares an inherited property with another name and value kind, the projection lists one property entry per definition and the overview answers, while revision 0 still lists one.
The quality of revisions 0, 1 and the head counts exactly the fixture's evidenced assertions, constrained properties and names shared within a type.
An assertion added at revision 1 and retracted at revision 2 is absent at 0, Active at 1, and Retracted but still projected at 2.
A store at head 0 projects revision 0 when asked for it by number, and refuses revision 1 as not found, naming the request and the head.
Since revision 0 at 3 lists revision 1 to 3's 7 changes by kind, since 2 the one retraction, since 1 at 1 nothing, and since 0 at 2 the 6 changes of revisions 1 and 2.
After one schema change the newest projection lists two versions and version 1's ontology, and a projection at revision 0 lists one version and version 0's ontology while the head is revision 1.
A search matching 600 nodes answers 100 at limit 100 and 1 at limit 1, reporting all 600, and refuses a limit of 101 or 0.
A text in no name or alias answers no match; a text found only after lowercasing answers Folded matches; an Exact alias match of degree 1 comes before a Folded name match of degree 600.
A store holding only its seed projects revision 0, with one schema version, one revision entry and no transaction id.
Hops 1 and 3 and limits 1 and 500 are answered; hops 0 or 4 and limit 0 or 501 are refused naming the first broken input, and an unknown subject answers no row.
Each holder's row counts the events its walk reaches within 1, 2 and 3 hops, by day or by week, and a subject asked for alone lists its events.
A transaction time before the seed lists all 12 changes from revision 0, and revision 1's own commit time lists only revisions 2 and 3.
A valid time of 1000 ms lists the 4 assertion changes valid after it and no node or edge, and 0 ms adds the seed's 2 assertions.
Since revision 0 at 3 lists both added evidence entries once among 8 changes, since 2 the one of revision 3, and since 1 at 2 or a valid time none.
The one assertion whose subject is an edge is projected under that edge.
Depth 0 and 2, limit 2,000 and edge_limit 5,000 are answered; depth 3 or -1, limit 2,001 or 0, edge_limit 5,001 or 0 and a negative cursor are refused, naming the first broken input.
By the overview's rule step is the one event type at every revision; naming note leaves its undated node out; an unknown name is refused.
The overview lists 300 top nodes by default, 500 and 1 at the bounds, and refuses a limit of 501 or 0.
An expansion with one unknown seed among known ones is refused naming it, two unknown seeds name the first given, and describing an unknown node is refused naming it.
A revision since of -1 is malformed before any bound, limit 0 or 2,001 and after -1 are refused, limit 2,000 and a valid time of -1 are answered, and since revision 9 is not found.
A consumer's sources are reported for every planted type, property, canonical and alias name with file and line, runtime words flagged and ids never; the answer is independent of source order.
An inherited Timestamp supplies event time, missing values are counted, and historical names and ambiguous timestamp values are checked at the requested revision.
All three evidence records a seed admits are projected, and all three as retained.
At edge_limit 100 the hub's neighbourhood pages as 102 nodes and 100 edges, then 100 and 100 starting with the edge the first page's last node closes.
The better-linked of two event types is the observation type, and the buckets turn from days to Monday weeks past a 120-day span.
